about: Isoptin SR (verapamil) is supplied five times from March to July 2026 for a man aged 70, by brand name only.
Diltiazem (Cardizem CD) is supplied four times in the middle of a 14-month history for a woman aged 74.
Norvasc (amlodipine, a calcium channel blocker not on the list) is supplied monthly, so nothing must flag.
